quotations.old_english: Hé þone hád mid efenwyrþum (-weorðum, v. l.) dǽdum frætwade
Hé þ-bar; bysceopsetl efenwyrðum (efenwyrðe, v. l.) dǽdum his hádes heóld
quotations.latin: episcopalem cathedram condignis gradu actibus seruat

source_text: very worthy; condignus:--Hé þone hád mid efenwyrþum (-weorðum, v. l.) dǽdum frætwade gradum condignis ornans actibus, Bd. 3, 27; Sch. 331, 23. Hé þ-bar; bysceopsetl efenwyrðum (efenwyrðe, v. l.) dǽdum his hádes heóld episcopalem cathedram condignis gradu actibus seruat, 5, 12; Sch. 632, 3.
